Hello, sorry to disturb you.

UPS marked the package as delivered, but it was not. They called my number
at 10:40, but I missed the call, and they never came to my address.

Normally they should attempt a second delivery, but what concerns me is
that they marked it as delivered.

I tried calling them for help. Unfortunately, their AI support was not
useful — I couldn’t get any assistance by phone, so I filed a claim.

The only advice their system gave me was to contact you (as the seller),
since you have better tools to follow up on the package. thanks

Fabio.
Handed to the team · Carrier trace and POD request on a parcel scanned delivered but not received, ne

Hi Fabio,

No disturbance at all, and I'm sorry about this.

I've pulled up your order ····, the Nexus S1, shipped from our Rotterdam warehouse. Our record shows the same thing you saw: a delivery scan this morning at 08:40, tracking ····. The parcel is not showing as returned to us, so a trace with the carrier is the right next step and I've put that in front of our logistics colleague. They pick it up today at 10am Eastern and will come back to you here with what the carrier says, including the proof of delivery and the exact address and signature on that scan.

Two things that often explain it, and both are worth a quick check this afternoon: a driver who cannot hand the parcel over will sometimes leave it at a nearby Access Point or with a neighbour, and the missed call at 10:40 may well have been him. If you find a notice card at your door, the number on it tells you where the parcel sits. Keep the claim you filed open either way, it does not conflict with what we are doing.

Please don't worry, we will not leave you without the unit.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hello Sarah, just a quick update on my situation.

No courier showed up today either. I registered on the UPS website, and the
personal dashboard showed something interesting: the package appears as
“incoming,” but the scheduled delivery is pending because an investigation
has been opened. Unfortunately, no other details are available.

The only option I had was to redirect the parcel to a nearby UPS Access
Point for collection, which I did. I don’t know anything else for now.

Thanks for your assistance!

Fabio I. giorno mar 20 ott 2026 alle ore 14:01 Sarah — HeliumDeploy Support <
(email hidden)> ha scritto:

Hi Fabio,

Thanks for the update, that is genuinely useful.

Redirecting it to an Access Point was the right call. It also tells us the parcel is accounted for and moving, not lost, which is the main thing. An open investigation usually means the carrier is reconciling that early delivery scan with the fact that the parcel is still in their hands, and the hold on the scheduled delivery stays until they close it.

Nothing has come back to our Rotterdam warehouse, so the unit is still on their side for collection. When you go to pick it up, take the tracking number ···· and a photo ID, since the parcel was redirected rather than addressed there originally, and some points ask for both.

Our logistics colleague has your case and is chasing the carrier from our end in parallel, so the two efforts meet in the middle. If you collect it before they get back to you, just reply here and we will close the trace. And if the Access Point does not have it within a few days, tell me and we will take it from there rather than leaving you waiting on the investigation.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hello Sarah, final update — good news!

I finally received the address of the UPS Access Point where they had
delivered my Nexus days ago, without notifying me at the time. I collected
it a few moments ago. The package was open, but after inspecting it I
decided to accept it. I brought it home, tested it, and everything seems to
be working fine.

I’m happy with my purchase!

Thanks for your time and help.

Fabio I. giorno mer 21 ott 2026 alle ore 18:50 Sarah — HeliumDeploy Support <

Hi Fabio,

That is great news, thank you for closing the loop with me.

One thing worth doing now that it is running: check the box contents against what should be there, the miner, the power supply, the EU plug lead and the stand. The parcel having been opened is not something I like, so if anything is missing or looks damaged, just reply here with a photo and we will send the part out free, no return needed. Same if the unit starts behaving oddly in the first days, since your order includes the Harlo OS Diagnostics with 3 months of RMA cover, so you are protected either way.

For setup tips, pool settings and firmware updates, you are very welcome in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf . JD and a lot of other S1 owners are active there and it is the fastest place to get a hands-on answer.

It was a pleasure helping you through this one, and I am glad it ended with the miner on your desk and hashing. If you were happy with how we handled it, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

Enjoy the Nexus, Fabio.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

hello, Sarah, i've got a problem!

 My Nexus shuts down with a regulator overvoltage fault.  firmware
is  BitLuck nexus.v1.0.4.4,  Harlo was never written to it because my grok
bot said the only Harlo file with a similar name would program the wrong
regulator, hardware was not modified.  It ran for a couple of days at 440
MHz and 950 mV, about 140 W, with the board near 60°C, never exceeding
temperature limits, It failed at 425 MHz and 930 mV at 132W.

The miner was hashing normally. It now stops as soon as it starts. The
display shows either of these:

• VOLTAGE PROTECTION, Guru Meditation #····
• VREG OVERHEATED, Guru Meditation #····

It seems the 12 V input is healthy. At the moment of the fault the miner
measures 12.09 V

A USB serial log of the boot shows the controller finds the TPS53647, sets
4 phases, and commands 0.93 V at 425 MHz. The four chips accept the clock.
Within a fraction of a second the regulator reports:
Note to the team: Handing this to Hal, our technical specialist, who picks up Fabio's message directly.

i don't have another power supply. there is no burning smell, mark on the

Hi Fabio,

Thank you, the full log and the photo of the serial label both came through, and they are exactly what was needed. They are with our technician now and he will come back to you in this thread with his reading of it. Our team is on from now, so this is being looked at today.

Two things in the meantime, so you are not left wondering. Please leave the unit unplugged until you hear back, since a board that trips its own voltage protection should not be asked to try again. And nothing you have described affects your cover. The firmware is the stock BitLuck build it shipped with, you never flashed anything, the hardware is untouched and the unit was run below its own limits, so that is a clean warranty position. Your order also carries the Harlo OS Diagnostics with 3 months of RMA cover from October 13. If the verdict is a hardware fault, the return and the replacement are handled by us and you pay nothing for shipping either way.

If you would like a faster back and forth in the meantime, JD and a lot of Nexus owners are in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf . Post the log there and mention @nullhashrate, that is JD. It does not replace the answer coming to you here, it is just quicker for a live look.

Sorry you are dealing with this after the trouble the parcel already gave you. We will see it through.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
